class.name: Xbox
class.brief_description: Root singleton for Microsoft GDK integration.
class.description: GDK is the engine singleton that provides access to Microsoft GDK runtime services including users, game UI, accessibility, achievements, package metadata/content access, stats, leaderboards, privacy, presence, social, store commerce, profile, string verification, Title Storage, error reporting, launcher, multiplayer activity, capture, system/runtime metadata, display (HDR/timeout deferral), and game activation events. Access via [code]GDK[/code] in GDScript after the extension loads. Call [method initialize] to start the runtime. By default the addon pumps completions automatically each process frame through [code]gdk/runtime/embed_dispatch[/code]; call [method dispatch] manually when that setting is disabled or when you need deterministic control. The engine singleton name is configurable through the Project Setting [code]gdk/runtime/singleton_name[/code] (default [code]GDK[/code]), for titles that need to avoid a name collision or prefer a project-specific global. Set it before the extension loads — it is read once at extension initialization, so changes require a restart. Values that are empty or not a valid ASCII identifier, or that collide with an already-registered singleton, are rejected with a warning and the default [code]GDK[/code] is used instead. When renamed, resolve the singleton with [code]Engine.get_singleton(ProjectSettings.get_setting("gdk/runtime/singleton_name", "GDK"))[/code] rather than the [code]GDK[/code] global.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Initializes the GDK runtime. When [param config] is a [Dictionary], the Xbox services bootstrap accepts the first matching SCID override key in this order: [code]scid[/code], [code]service_configuration_id[/code], [code]xbox_live/scid[/code], then nested [code]xbox_live.scid[/code]. If no override is supplied, the addon derives the current-title SCID from [code]XGameGetXboxTitleId()[/code]. Calling this again while the runtime is already active returns [code]XboxResult.code == "already_initialized"[/code], so repeated startup paths should guard with [method is_initialized].

method.name: shutdown
method.description: Shuts down the GDK runtime and releases all resources. Pending one-shot async signals are completed with [code]XboxResult.code == "cancelled"[/code] so awaiting scripts resume.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when this build was compiled with [code]_GAMING_DESKTOP[/code] support. Non-Gaming-Desktop builds return [code]false[/code].

method.name: is_initialized
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the GDK runtime has been successfully initialized.

method.name: dispatch
method.description: Manually pumps the GDK async task queue and manager-driven state. Use this when [code]gdk/runtime/embed_dispatch[/code] is disabled or when you want deterministic control over completion timing. Returns the number of tasks dispatched.

method.name: get_users
method.description: Returns the [XboxUsers] service for managing Xbox user sign-in and identity.

method.name: get_game_ui
method.description: Returns the [XboxGameUI] service for PC-supported system UI flows.

method.name: get_achievements
method.description: Returns the [XboxAchievements] service for querying and updating Xbox achievements.

method.name: get_package
method.description: Returns the [XboxPackage] service for package enumeration, package mounts, and resource-pack loading helpers.

method.name: get_stats
method.description: Returns the [XboxStats] service for querying, staging, flushing, tracking, and caching Xbox Services user statistics.

method.name: get_leaderboards
method.description: Returns the [XboxLeaderboards] service for Xbox Services leaderboard queries and pagination.

method.name: get_privacy
method.description: Returns the [XboxPrivacy] service for Xbox Services privacy permission checks and avoid/mute list queries.

method.name: get_accessibility
method.description: Returns the [XboxAccessibility] service for concrete PC accessibility APIs.

method.name: get_presence
method.description: Returns the XboxPresence service for managing rich presence.

method.name: get_social
method.description: Returns the XboxSocial service for social features.

method.name: get_store
method.description: Returns the XboxStore service for XStore commerce operations.

method.name: get_profile
method.description: Returns the [XboxProfile] service for Xbox Services profile lookups.

method.name: get_string_verify
method.description: Returns the [XboxStringVerify] service for Xbox Services text verification.

method.name: get_title_storage
method.description: Returns the [XboxTitleStorage] service for Xbox Services Title Storage.

method.name: get_error_reporting
method.description: Returns the [XboxErrorReporting] service for [code]XError[/code] callback and option configuration.

method.name: get_launcher
method.description: Returns the [XboxLauncher] service for supported URI launch flows on PC GDK.

method.name: get_multiplayer_activity
method.description: Returns the XboxMultiplayerActivity service for multiplayer activity management.

method.name: get_capture
method.description: Returns the [XboxCapture] service for capture metadata and capture-state management.

method.name: get_system
method.description: Returns the XboxSystem service for title/runtime metadata and environment facts.

method.name: get_display
method.description: Returns the [XboxDisplay] service for HDR mode probing/enable and idle display-timeout deferrals.

method.name: get_activation
method.description: Returns the [XboxActivation] service for game activation events (protocol/file/invite launches).

method.name: get_networking
method.description: Returns the [XboxNetworking] service for the preferred local UDP multiplayer port, connectivity hints, and endpoint security information.

signal.name: initialized
signal.description: Emitted when the GDK runtime has been successfully initialized.

signal.name: shutdown_completed
signal.description: Emitted when the GDK runtime has completed shutdown.

signal.name: runtime_error
signal.description: Emitted when an [code]XError[/code] runtime error is reported by the GDK error-reporting bridge. After the result-only refactor, this root signal is reserved for unsolicited X-error events; per-service async failures are surfaced on the service's own [code]runtime_error[/code] signal (for example [code]GDK.social.runtime_error[/code], [code]GDK.achievements.runtime_error[/code]).
